title: Hinton thanks Wilson and asks for closing words
summary: Hinton thanks Wilson and his sons and asks for a message for posterity.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well, I tell you, this has been a joy, just to do this session with you, and Teddy -- it's ridiculous to even mention how much, and I thank you so much for sharing this with me, sharing your sons with me and their friendship and your friendship down through these years. This is something to sustain me for the rest of my life.

Now is there anything that you'd like to say to -- this is for posterity, for young people to know about and for old people to know about a great human being and a great musician like you, and the dignity that you have held in this business. Any important thing that you want to say? I
know you've said it all, but anything else you'd like to say in closing.
